description.value: Creston Hotel & Suites is a hotel in Creston, BC with wireless internet access. Located at 1418 Canyon Street, it provides accommodation for travelers visiting the area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetch failed due to SSL error, so assessment is based solely on OSM data. OSM confirms a functioning hotel in Creston with wireless internet access. Specific bike storage, breakfast, and other cyclist amenities cannot be verified and are marked null; only the Wi-Fi amenity is confirmed from OSM tags.
concerns: Website fetch failed due to SSL error—amenities and cyclist services unverifiable
